note: Structure only: values, paths, durations, and versions are deliberately excluded so the snapshot is stable across machines and releases.

syncExecuted.description: Whether uv lock --check / uv sync actually ran.

includeUnused.description: Also report declared packages that no file imports. Off by default because runtime plugins and console tools produce false positives.

output.description: Bounded stdout/stderr from the failing command.

path.description: Project directory used to classify the missing module.
Project directory, pyproject.toml path, or uv.lock path.

extras.description: Whether sync requests every [project.optional-dependencies] extra. Defaults to all: without it uv removes extras such as the dev tooling.

mode.description: check runs uv lock --check; sync runs uv sync --frozen --all-groups --all-extras.

extraArgs.description: Extra pytest arguments passed verbatim as an argument array, e.g. ["--cov=my_pkg", "--cov-branch"] or ["-m", "unit"].

lastFailed.description: Rerun only tests that failed last time (--lf).

path.description: Project directory to audit; defaults to the project root.

changedPaths.description: Changed paths; defaults to git diff plus untracked files.

path.description: Project directory to scan for test files.

testFiles.description: Known test files; defaults to a project scan.

quality.description: Run the lint/type tools the project declares (ruff, pyright, and mypy when [tool.mypy] exists). Defaults to true.
